historical_weight: Records the conceptual origin of the current JANUS P-vs-NP program.
Preserves the early dual architecture: imaginative synthesis paired with an anti-pseudoscience complexity critic.
Documents the transition from game/simulation metaphors toward formal verification and proof-carrying requirements.
known_limits: mod_pvsnp.py used LLM scoring/synthesis and is not a SAT solver or verifier
the historical Complexity Tutor had runtime defects and heuristic regex checks
no historical result from these sources is admitted into the current proof chain
